title: Knowledge Graphs Quality Assessment in the Era of LLMs: A Conceptual Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.31684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have been popularized during the last few decades and are increasingly constructed and consumed by Large Language Models (LLMs). Various applications therefore rely on KGs to provide concise, complete, accurate, faithful, fresh, and traceable answers. However, what is the quality of those KGs? In which cases should a KG be used, and can it be trusted to ground an LLM? How might it be evaluated? We reviewed the literature on quality assessment (QA) of data, information, linked data, KGs, and the intersection of KGs and LLMs. We extended the current state-of-the-art frameworks to a catalog of 24 quality dimensions (QDs) and various quality metrics (QMs). Furthermore, we propose a general-purpose, customizable to a domain or task, and practical QA framework for assessing the quality of KGs.

translated_title: 大语言模型时代的知识图谱质量评估：一个概念框架
translated_abstract: 知识图谱（KGs）在过去几十年中得到了广泛普及，并且越来越多地由大语言模型（LLMs）构建和消费。因此，各种应用依赖知识图谱来提供简洁、完整、准确、忠实、新鲜且可追溯的答案。然而，这些知识图谱的质量究竟如何？在哪些情况下应该使用知识图谱？它是否可以被信任用于为大语言模型提供事实依据？又该如何对其进行评估？我们回顾了关于数据、信息、关联数据、知识图谱以及知识图谱与大语言模型交叉领域的质量评估（QA）文献。我们将当前最先进的框架扩展为一个包含24个质量维度（QDs）和多种质量指标（QMs）的目录。此外，我们提出了一个通用的、可针对特定领域或任务定制的、实用的质量评估框架，用于评估知识图谱的质量。
tldr: 本文回顾了数据、信息、关联数据及知识图谱与大语言模型交叉领域的质量评估文献，将现有最先进框架扩展为包含24个质量维度的目录，并提出了一种通用、可按领域或任务定制且实用的知识图谱质量评估概念框架。
en_tdlr: This paper extends state-of-the-art quality assessment frameworks into a catalog of 24 quality dimensions and proposes a general-purpose, domain-customizable, and practical conceptual framework for evaluating knowledge graph quality in the era of LLMs.
